comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber, versus arrange candles according to type-dependent spacing and clearance rules.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision tool/collar contact and response-guided iteration; record requires object placement with spatial safety reasoning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires repeatable bounded impacts. Record requires 3/7 cm inter-candle spacing as applicable, 30 cm flammable clearance, and 50 cm overhead clearance.
comparison.reason: Rule-constrained layout is a different tested ability from mechanical adjustment and force/travel validation. Shared safety awareness alone does not establish overlap.
